headline: ApyHub builds MCP server with 1,500+ tools for AI agents from a single connector
summary: ApyHub's new MCP server allows AI agents to access over 1,500 tools and endpoints through one connection, streamlining complex workflows without pre-building them.
details: ApyHub has developed an MCP server that provides AI agents access to over 1,500 tools and endpoints via a single connector. This eliminates the need to wire individual APIs, allowing agents to search, find, and call necessary APIs dynamically.

The platform includes more than 400 services covering file conversion, OCR, data extraction, validation, geolocation, SEO, image processing, and AI. This broad catalog enables agents to perform complex tasks like processing scanned invoices or summarizing webpages.

Agents can compose calls based on the task at hand, rather than relying on pre-built workflows. This approach prevents "tool bloat" by allowing developers to select specific endpoints for different agent types, such as a document agent using 15-20 relevant endpoints.

The server also simplifies API key management. Instead of storing multiple API keys for various vendors in the agent's environment, the MCP server centralizes access, reducing exposure in logs and observability tools.

headline_marked: [[Roborock unveils Saros 20 Flow Complete]] with 36,000Pa suction and self-cleaning mop at IFA 2026
headline: Roborock unveils Saros 20 Flow Complete with 36,000Pa suction and self-cleaning mop at IFA 2026
summary: The new top-tier robot vacuum features Reactive AI, AdaptiLift tech, and a continuously washed roller mop system for hands-free maintenance, expected this Fall.
details: Roborock unveiled its latest lineup of smart home cleaning devices at IFA 2026, focusing on enhanced hands-free cleaning and maintenance. The new products include advanced robot vacuums and a powerful wet-dry vacuum.

Headlining the new offerings is the Saros 20 Flow Complete, boasting an impressive 36,000Pa of suction power and LiDAR navigation. It also features Reactive AI capable of recognizing over 300 types of obstacles.

The Flow Complete incorporates Roborock's AdaptiLift technology, allowing it to raise itself by up to 8.8cm to navigate various surfaces and obstacles. Its innovative self-cleaning roller mop system continuously rinses dirt while wetting the mop with fresh water.

This ensures only a clean section touches the floor, and the mop can slide outward to clean right up against walls and edges. US pricing and availability are not yet confirmed, but it's expected to arrive around November.

Also introduced was the more affordable Saros 20 Neo, which shares the AdaptiLift technology and 36,000Pa suction. It is notably slimmer at 7.95cm tall and features a retractable LiDAR sensor for reaching under low furniture.
The Saros 20 Neo will launch in the U.S. as the Qrevo Edge 3 Pro, with a starting price of $1,500. It offers a strong cleaning performance without the Flow Complete's advanced self-cleaning mop.

Completing the lineup is the F25 Ultra Steam Gen 2 wet-dry vacuum, featuring an integrated steam function. This system applies steam at up to 180 degrees Celsius within 30 seconds to soften and loosen stubborn stains before mopping.
Like the robot vacuums, the F25 Ultra Steam Gen 2 prioritizes low maintenance, automatically cleaning and drying itself after use. This keeps the roller ready and prevents odors from building up.

US pricing for the F25 Ultra Steam Gen 2 is not yet available, but it is scheduled to launch in the U.S. on September 29. Roborock aims to provide a comprehensive and effortless cleaning experience across its new range.
